Rachel / Ben — a few marketplace-specific points to flag before Deal Desk submission:

1) AWS private offers: Marketplace will accept private offers but listing concessions need to be mapped to the published SKU. We may need AWS Marketplace enablement approval if the concession exceeds our delegated publish thresholds.
2) Co-sell credit: to claim co-sell credits we need partner registration + account plan in Partner Central — that’s usually quick but needs to be in place before we push joint marketing assets.
3) Timing: AWS side approvals can take 5–7 business days if escalated; make sure the PO and SOW are final to avoid churn.

I'll compile a short Deal Desk packet (one-pager + pricing model + PO) and share a DocuSign link if you want me to route. For now I recommend we escalate formally to Deal Desk with the proposed 20% concession and include Scenario B as fallback.
